description.narrative: Improved circumstances for women and girls in South Sudan and more opportunities for women in leadership positions.

Within the Leaders of Peace project there are 3 result areas: improved implementation of policies and regulations on GBV and protection of W/G including psychosocial support and self- care. Changed attitudes and beliefs of civil society to facilitate inclusion of W/G and promote gender equality. Increased and effective participation of W/Y in leadership and Peace building.
Women and girls and women in leadership positions.

sector.narrative: Ending violence against women and girls
Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of women, women's rights organisations, CSO's, government & private sector to enhance women's rights, empowerment and gender equality
# of women led CSOs with strengthened capacity to advance women's rights and gender equality

comment.narrative: CSO’s have capacity to conduct L&A activities inidividually at grassroots level on ending GBV and female participation, with limited linkages to the other CSO’s and no coordinated advocacy initiatives at national and international level.

Ultimate 5-years target: The CSO’s jointly conduct lobby & advocacy initiatives at both grassroots, national and international level. The consortium is coordinating L&A initiatives together with other CSO’s in the country as well as embassies and international bodies on women-peace and security. The CSO’s are able to influence powerholders and policy-makers on ensuring WPS is a priority on their agenda
1 staff joined the advocacy working group and capacitated to jointly conduct lobby and advocacy activities

Ultimate 5-years target: The CSO’s jointly conduct lobby & advocacy initiatives at both grassroots, national and international level. The consortium is coordinating L&A initiatives together with other CSO’s in the country as well as embassies and international bodies on women-peace and security. The CSO’s are able to influence powerholders and policy-makers on ensuring WPS is a priority on their agenda

Staff attended a training and follow-up sessions as consortium on advocacy intentions and joint development of an advocacy strategy. The Lobby & Advocacy strategy includes a roadmap of activities to be implemented. Progress will be identified following successful implementation of the roadmap as well as a CSO’s assessment will be conducted during the next project period followed by more specific training offered by PAX HQ experts.

Ultimate 5-years target: The CSO’s jointly conduct lobby & advocacy initiatives at both grassroots, national and international level. The consortium is coordinating L&A initiatives together with other CSO’s in the country as well as embassies and international bodies on women-peace and security. The CSO’s are able to influence powerholders and policy-makers on ensuring WPS is a priority on their agenda

Staff of 1 female led organisations attended participated in the designing of the activities for lobby and advocacy strategy organised by PAX in South Sudan as well as attended the launching of the published lobby and advocacy strategy in Juba South Sudan. Follow up on the use of the lobby and advocacy strategy will be conducted during the annual reflection workshop
